prompt:
Create a 3x3 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG, overworld walking sprites.

Image 1 is a POSE GUIDE: grey mannequins on white, one per cell. Draw the SAME character once in every cell, matching that cell's mannequin pose, position and size exactly. Light grey limbs are the far side, dark grey limbs the near side; the light patch and nose bump on the head show which way the face points.

Image 2 is a STYLE REFERENCE only (bead versions of classic battle sprites): match its chunky proportions (about 2.5 heads tall, oversized head, big fists and boots), black outlines around and between parts, and flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour. Do NOT copy those characters and do NOT draw bead texture.

Image 3 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved sprite sheet of a DIFFERENT character from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, figure height, proportions, outline weight, shading and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy its costume, colours, hair or face.

Image 4 is the APPROVED LOOK of THIS character in battle poses (pixel art). Keep the same face, hair, colours, costume shapes and proportions.

The grey mannequins are ONLY a pose guide: never draw grey limbs or grey shapes; draw the character's own sleeves, hands and held items in every cell.

FACE: a closed helm: no face is visible, only two glowing red eyes in the visor slit (front view); back views show the helm and cape.

Render as true pixel art: each character about 42 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no soft shading. Each row is one walking direction; the three cells of a row are a walk cycle, so the legs must visibly change between them.

Character: towering dark knight in heavy midnight-blue plate armour with gold trim, a full helm crowned with two large curved ivory horns, two glowing red eyes in the visor slit, broad layered pauldrons and a long dark red cape; a broad steel greatsword in a scabbard on his back, empty hands. Keep every costume detail identical in every cell.

Cells:
- top row, left cell: standing still, walking toward the viewer, full front view, face and both eyes visible.
- top row, middle cell: mid-step with the left foot clearly forward, walking toward the viewer, full front view, face and both eyes visible.
- top row, right cell: mid-step with the right foot clearly forward, walking toward the viewer, full front view, face and both eyes visible.
- middle row, left cell: standing still, walking away from the viewer, full back view seen from directly behind: back of the helmet or hair and the cape, NO face, eyes, nose or mouth visible.
- middle row, middle cell: mid-step with the left foot clearly forward, walking away from the viewer, full back view seen from directly behind: back of the helmet or hair and the cape, NO face, eyes, nose or mouth visible.
- middle row, right cell: mid-step with the right foot clearly forward, walking away from the viewer, full back view seen from directly behind: back of the helmet or hair and the cape, NO face, eyes, nose or mouth visible.
- bottom row, left cell: standing still, walking in full side profile facing left, nose pointing left, one eye visible.
- bottom row, middle cell: mid-step with the left foot clearly forward, walking in full side profile facing left, nose pointing left, one eye visible.
- bottom row, right cell: mid-step with the right foot clearly forward, walking in full side profile facing left, nose pointing left, one eye visible.

Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no grid lines, no borders, no text or labels.
Avoid: multiple weapons, extra swords, floating objects, props on the ground, duplicate characters, facing right, blurry, soft shading, gradient, airbrush, photo, 3d render, realistic, text, watermark, frame, border, grid lines, shadow on ground, sword, weapon, scabbard, held object, items on the ground.
